industrial_report_versions.boundary: ISO 14067 and wafer fabrication services PCR, raw material extraction to completed manufacturing
industrial_report_versions.version_note: Product assessment goes annual from 2025 with third-party verification every three years. Corporate Scope 3 inventory has a revised boundary. The overlapping 8-inch 2020 and 2023 chart values agree with the prior report.
The report attributes part of the 2023 change to expanded raw-material scope and to utilization. Its adjacent chart is a water footprint in m3 per wafer.

provenance_rule: Numeric scenario parameters cite rows in sources.csv. Sources without an observed matching value remain unavailable. Tiers describe compatibility and never promote a wafer category to a specific process.
